Every client's notes, visits

hero.sub: VI One is a salon CRM for solo beauty pros. Your client book, your appointment book and your sales tracker in one iPhone app — and a heads-up when a regular goes quiet or quietly starts spending less.

what.h2: The client book that keeps itself
what.lead: You are the front desk, the artist and the bookkeeper. VI One takes the remembering.

cards.p: Notes, photos, phone, Instagram handle and the full visit history on a single client profile. Write it once; it stays current.
New, Regular, VIP and At risk are set from real visits and real spend — not from a tag you meant to add three months ago.
VI One learns each client's own rhythm. When someone who books every four weeks reaches week seven, you hear about it while a message still works.
The client who still comes in but books the cheaper service. VI One watches average ticket per client and flags the slide before it becomes a goodbye.
Your own menu and your own prices. Request → confirmed → done, with no-shows recorded against the client so the pattern is visible.
Log a sale in seconds. Per-client totals and this month's revenue, without opening a spreadsheet at midnight.
Record a client call and VI One writes the summary and the keywords onto their card — so "she wants to move her fill to Saturday" is still there next month.
cards.note: Record calls only where you are permitted to and with everyone's knowledge.

cards.p: Most new clients find you there. Open a client's DM thread straight from their card instead of hunting the handle.

look.h2: Built for a one-chair studio, not a call center
look.lead: Open the app and the day is already sorted: who is coming, who has gone quiet, and what the month looks like so far.

— lapsed and at-risk clients, each with how long they usually wait and what they usually spend
— notes, visits, every payment, call keywords and booking history in one scroll
(Pro) — where the month's revenue came from and which clients moved

whoFor.h2: If you keep the client book in your head
whoFor.lead: VI One was built for one person running the whole chair — and for small studios where everyone still knows every client by name.

honest.h2: What VI One does not do in the US
honest.lead: Some of what VI One does in Korea is not switched on here yet. You should know that before you download, not after.

items.t: VI One records what you were paid and what for. It does not take the payment or touch your card processor.

items.b: Automatic text reminders are not live in the US.
items.t: They run in Korea today. US texting needs a carrier-verified number, which is in progress — until it is done, you send reminders yourself.
The AI that answers repeat questions needs an inbound number we do not have in the US yet. The AI that summarizes your recorded calls works today.
That is a Korean messaging channel. It is simply not on your screen here.

pricing.h2: Start free. Stay free until Pro is worth it.
pricing.lead: No trial countdown and no card to start — Starter is the whole client book, permanently free.

starter.name: Starter
items: Unlimited client cards with notes and photos
Automatic New / Regular / VIP / At risk tiers
Appointment book with your own menu
Quick sales log and monthly revenue
starter.fine: This is the honest pick in the US today — everything above works right now.

pro.name: Pro
items: Automatic reminders — Korea only for now
AI FAQ auto-reply — Korea only for now
pro.fine: Two of the four Pro features are not switched on in the US yet, so in the US Pro adds the monthly report and little else. Current price is shown in the App Store. We will update this page the day that changes.

who.h2: One person you can actually email

VI One is that work pointed at a one-chair studio instead of a boardroom: designed, built, shipped and supported by the same person. It is on the App Store, not in a slide deck.
